measure.measure_definition: Measured value: adjusted mean Numerical Pain Rating Scale score at baseline or week 10; mean differences summarize the same score; Participants; Numerical Pain Rating Scale (NPRS) self-report: pain over the past 7 days rated 0 (no pain) to 10 (worst possible pain). Questionnaires completed in person at baseline and 10 weeks. Mixed-design ANCOVA adjusted for age, sex, BMI, and low back pain duration.; NPRS score range 0–10; higher score indicates worse pain. Adjusted means, within-group mean differences, between-group mean differences, and group × time interaction were estimated; no responder threshold used.

Measured value: adjusted mean Modified Oswestry Disability Index score at baseline or week 10; mean differences summarize the same score; Participants; Modified Oswestry Disability Index (ODI) version 2.0, 10-item self-report; each item scored 0–5; completed at baseline and 10 weeks. Mixed-design ANCOVA adjusted for age, sex, BMI, and low back pain duration.; Modified ODI total score; higher score indicates greater disability. The paper describes categories minimal, moderate, severe, completely disabled, or bedridden but does not use a category threshold for the adjusted analysis.

Measured value: adjusted mean Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale score at baseline or week 10; mean differences summarize the same score; Participants; Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS), 14 items (7 anxiety, 7 depression), each item 0–3; reported as a single 'Anxiety & Depression (HADS)' score. Completed at baseline and 10 weeks. Mixed-design ANCOVA adjusted for age, sex, BMI, and low back pain duration.; Higher score indicates greater anxiety/depression. The paper describes separate anxiety and depression subscales each scored 0–21 (normal 0–7, borderline 8–10, abnormal 11–21), but reports only the combined HADS outcome and does not explicitly define the combined score. Separate subscale values were not reported.

population.intervention: Aquatic therapy: standardized aquatic exercise program including aerobic conditioning, dynamic lumbar stabilization, resistance training, and stretching/mobility exercises.
population.intervention_regimen: 2 sessions/week for 10 weeks; 60 minutes per session; one-on-one supervised sessions in a heated therapeutic pool.
population.population_definition: Randomized allocation to aquatic therapy; analyzed group with baseline and 10-week data; Adults aged 18–65 years with chronic nonspecific low back pain >3 months, moderate or severe disability on modified Oswestry Disability Index (21–60%), currently seeking care for low back pain, able to communicate in English or French, and not currently engaged in sports or fitness training specifically for the lower back muscles in the prior 3 months. Excluded for neurological signs/nerve root compression, prior spinal surgery or vertebral fracture, major lumbar structural abnormality, comorbid condition preventing exercise, or missing more than 7 of 20 exercise sessions. Participants had baseline and 10-week data and were included in the aquatic therapy analyzed group (n=18).
population.population_time_frame: Recruitment October 2022 to December 2023; baseline assessment before intervention; outcomes at baseline and 10 weeks.

population.intervention: Standard care: individualized manual therapy and exercise therapy.
population.intervention_regimen: 2 sessions/week for 10 weeks; 60 minutes per session; one-on-one supervised sessions in the athletic therapy clinic and conditioning floor.

Excluded for neurological signs/nerve root compression, prior spinal surgery or vertebral fracture, major lumbar structural abnormality, comorbid condition preventing exercise, or missing more than 7 of 20 exercise sessions. Participants had baseline and 10-week data and were included in the standard care analyzed group (n=16).

population.intervention: Aquatic therapy or standard care (manual therapy and exercise).
